card.title: Nintendo Switch SSM6P49NU buck regulator and charging troubleshooting guide

source.title: Identification of SSM6P49NU MOSFET on Nintendo Switch motherboard

symptoms: won't wake up from sleep mode

claims.statement: Nintendo recommends resetting the official AC adapter by unplugging it for at least 30 seconds and plugging the USB-C directly into the Switch if there is a blank screen or it won't wake up from sleep mode.
claims.evidence: Text at the top of the image detailing the reset procedure.

claims.statement: The SSM6P49NU is a dual channel MOSFET acting as a dc-dc converter/buck regulator to step down vbus voltage (20v max) to 5v max on that rail.
claims.evidence: Text next to the green board close-up referencing the pointed IC and stating 'UPDATE: So it's a dual channel MOSFET. SSM6P49NU'.

card.caveats: Does not show explicit pinout measurements or schematic diagrams for the SSM6P49NU.
